title: Deeper and broader peer release-versus-branch readiness refresh
mode: primary-source web research and read-only local implementation-plan/source reconciliation
scope: Recheck current published and unreleased ACIS/AcDs peer paths
Separate release behavior, open-branch claims, issue reports, carrier preservation, and semantic shape evidence
Refine existing local 3D carrier and composed-consumer gates without adding per-slice validation cost

method.kind: Read current upstream release pages, issues, pull requests, documentation, and targeted local implementation paths
method.limitations: Mutable upstream pages and user issue reports are not independent reproductions. Open PR branch state was inspected but not built or run. The ezdxf mesh-derived example is carrier-generation evidence only, not a qualified analytic B-rep. No external payload, customer drawing, native consumer, or peer executable was tested.

sources.revision: v3.8.0 tagged commit 3a1c66b and mutable issue/repository pages reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The format/version matrix is not a per-family retention guarantee. Open issue #1195 reports ACIS-bearing 3DSOLID/REGION read but silently omitted by the DXF writer on unavailable customer drawings; this is a reporter claim, not a reproduction.

sources.project: ACadSharp ACIS writer and storage branches
sources.revision: Open PR state and comments reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: #1240 remains open, depends on #1174, and has no deployment; #1174 remains open. A contributor reports one branch test failing because readAcdsRecord is NotImplementedException and the branch DXF path losing post-2013 payloads. The reported branch test was not rerun in this research.

sources.revision: Open issue and mutable NEWS reviewed 2026-10-18; issue reporter pins tested executable to 0.14.8593 / commit prefix 8a1ae764
sources.observed: Open issue #1411 describes an R2013+ AcDs/SAB loss route where modeler entity identity survives but payload does not. The proposed no-proprietary-file repro uses ezdxf body_from_mesh(cube()); it is suitable as a carrier association scenario, not a curved/analytic B-rep oracle. NEWS documents prior incomplete/brute-force extraction of AcDb:AcDsPrototype_1b.

ezdxf provides bounded SAT/SAB carrier authoring and inspection, but the drawing backend does not render ACIS or provide a general 3D renderer; mesh-derived bodies do not constitute an independent analytic-kernel result.

The implementation contains distinct modeler payload parsing, AcDs section capture, record linking, and output validation paths; this source structure does not by itself qualify all external/native routes or body semantics.

assessment.planImpact: Refines existing S2.3 and PAR-07/S8 work: require per-entity carrier presence/hash and AcDs owner/key linkage independently from modeler-entity count; distinguish mesh-derived carrier controls from analytic semantic controls; and treat unreleased peer branches as experiments, not release evidence.

implementationReadyChecks: Continue independent local slices without waiting for peer or native availability.
Use only locally scratch-generated controls; do not add customer or peer corpus DWG/DXF files.
A mesh-derived SAT/SAB case can test payload presence and owner association only; use a separately qualified analytic geometry case for shape semantics.
Assert source entity and owner path, AcDs record/key, payload length/hash/profile, output carrier, and output disposition independently.
Pin peer release versus open PR head, build/runtime, options, diagnostics, and output hashes before using any comparator result.
Keep native Linux/Windows FreeCAD and independent semantic routes at composed gates; missing external evidence is recorded as NOT_RUN or NOT_AVAILABLE and does not stop local work.
After each implementation slice is committed, update the plan status/next action and report progress; this research pass itself made no commit.
